# Music Lab SoundFonts

Put durable Music Lab instrument assets here:

- `.sf2`
- `.sf3`
- `.sfz`

Music Lab auto-detects this folder for `backend=auto` and `backend=soundfont`.
Optional FluidSynth binaries belong under `external/tools/fluidsynth` or on
`PATH`.

Current local development asset:

- `GeneralUser GS v1.471.sf2`
- `GeneralUser GS v1.471 LICENSE.txt`

Keep the license text next to any durable SoundFont checked into this folder.

Do not store SoundFonts, sample packs, or synth tools in `debugCapture`; that
folder is disposable proof/scratch space.
